report.root_cause: Player TNT_Tommy systematically broke a wall of oak planks and glass panes at world x=14, z=8..14, y=-60..-56. This is about 35 blocks and is recorded in plugins/BlockLog/blocks.csv. The breaking began right after he joined. The server never crashed or lagged.
report.actions: Monitored status and logs. Saw RCON set TNT_Tommy and Mira_Crafts to creative and teleport them. Read BlockLog and found TNT_Tommy breaking a block roughly every 1.2 s. Mira_Crafts was only placing cobblestone at x=-22..-17, z=20..21, which looks like normal building. Declared the incident and banned TNT_Tommy. Confirmed he was disconnected and no further break entries appeared.
report.residual_risk: The ~35 destroyed blocks at x=14, z=8..14 have not been restored. The owner should be told, and the wall can be rebuilt from the BlockLog entries or a backup in backups/. I did not check who owns that wall or whether the area is protected. The server is in offline mode, so TNT_Tommy can rejoin under a different name. Creative mode was granted via RCON during the shift.
